title: Improvements feedback
body:
Hi.

The app is great.

However kindly consider adding a search feature like in Google Keep’s app. This will make it easier to fetch info on the app. 

The memory of the app is also quite short. If I was on an open note in Task app, then get off the app for a short moment while on another app, then get back on Task App, the open note will have closed.

I’m using iOS.
author: IanSmokeyice

title: More flexibility needed
body: The app needs more flexibility. Borrow from Microsoft To Do.
author: The254Governor

title: Automatic date syncing and data saving
body:
You should have a feature where it can directly sync a message from gmail with the right date. 
Also it should be able to save your tasks rather than deleting it.
author: Oshariff
